method: Relevant official chapter passages inspected; friction, tyre advice, syllabus and speed provisions also reuse same-day M07/M06 inspection. sources.finding: Ordinary B car/light goods vehicle limit of 3,500 kg registered total weight.
B trailer alternatives, B96 and the distinction between registered entitlement weights and actual technical loading.
Current B/B96/BE limits and historical entitlement caveats; conventional braked and unbraked trailer speed conditions. No universal 80 km/h permission inferred.
Registration fields O.1/O.2 and F.3, actual towing and actual combination limits are separate from entitlement.
Ready weight, total weight, actual gross weight and maximum load definitions; car ready weight includes driver and trailer ready weight excludes cargo.

Chapter 3 §§78–83 confirms securing, unobstructed controls/signals and projection marking. Chapter 4 §§15–17 confirms ordinary width/length restrictions and exemptions. Chapter 4 §20 version applicable before 1 December 2026 supports the scoped 80/40/30 trailer limits; future amendment not applied early. Chapter 3 §14 supports appropriate speed.
Cargo restraint, low supported loading, roof/equipment capacity and trailer checks. Entitlement details use the more specific Transportstyrelsen guidance, not this page’s abbreviated B/BE summary.
Registered owner’s compulsory-insurance duty for an on-road car, including unused/defective/prohibited vehicles, and the limited scope of compulsory cover.
Normal light-car inspection sequence 36/24/14 months and recalculation after an earlier inspection.
Official on/off-road services; on-road use requires insurance and vehicle tax. Status is a separate check from inspection and physical readiness.
Mina sidor eligibility, latest part 2 for applicable written transfers; buyer insurance from notified ownership date and automatic ending of seller insurance.
Part 1 technical details and part 2 ownership function; latest issued certificate only, with safe document handling.
Crashworthiness and assistance systems form parts of modern vehicle safety; ratings are not collision-avoidance guarantees.
30 June 2026 tests show automatic braking does not remove severe truck-trailer collision risk; no numerical guarantee imported.
VTI report section 4.3 supports combined steering/braking forces within available friction; same-day M07 source inspection reused.
Stability control, tyres and appropriate speed/distance; same-day M07 source inspection reused.
Plug-in hybrids use both electrical and combustion propulsion; no assumption that every journey is electric.
Self-assessment and identification of personal knowledge gaps; same-day M07 official syllabus inspection reused.

G8_sources.title: Lastbil
G8_sources.excerpt: Lätt lastbil får köra den hastighet som gäller för vägen.
G8_sources.supports: Light lorry ≤3.5 tonnes total weight; heavy >3.5; heavy 90 on motorway/expressway without trailer, 80 on other roads or towing; light without trailer follows road maximum.
G8_sources.scope_limits: Light-lorry statement explicitly scoped to no trailer. Lower road limit still binds heavy lorry; towing light lorry needs M08-L02 combination check. No inference that light lorry towing may always use road maximum.
G8_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

G8_sources.supports: Safe-speed adaptation depends on road/weather/visibility/load and foreseeable stopping distance.

G8_sources.title: Lasta bilen säkert
G8_sources.excerpt: Var noga med släpkärrans kultryck så att inte bilen eller kärran lyfter sig.
G8_sources.supports: Incorrect coupling pressure can lift car/trailer and harm handling.
G8_sources.scope_limits: Agency safety background; does not state exact front-axle unloading/steering-grip mechanism or universal numeric towball limit.
G8_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

G8_sources.title: Towing a Trailer in Oregon — Being Equipped for Safety
G8_sources.version: Live agency-hosted 32-page brochure; publication date not printed in inspected text
G8_sources.locator: If You Already Have a Tow Vehicle, printed page 6 / PDF page 8; definitions/ratings pp.4–6
G8_sources.excerpt: the tow vehicle will be less responsive to steering
G8_sources.supports: Downward tongue/hitch load defined; excessive load leaves too little weight on front wheels and reduces steering response. Follow actual vehicle/hitch ratings.
G8_sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV kultryck searches found lifting/handling cautions and calculator scope limits, not the complete front-wheel mechanism. Exact official ODOT brochure passage selected; manufacturer fallback unnecessary.
G8_sources.scope_limits: Conventional rear towball/coupling load explanation, not fifth-wheel geometry. No US percentage, hitch modification recipe, numeric load limit, registration or towing law imported. Front unloading means reduced axle load, not necessarily wheels leaving the road.
G8_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

G8_sources.title: Besiktning av fordon
G8_sources.locator: Opening owner responsibility; Vad händer om jag inte besiktar i tid? — Körförbud
G8_sources.excerpt: Om du inte besiktar fordonet i tid, får du automatiskt körförbud
G8_sources.supports: Automatic overdue-inspection prohibition, owner responsibility even without invitation, restricted trips for on/off-road vehicle; dangerous-condition prohibition distinct.
G8_sources.scope_limits: Inträtt körförbud due missed periodic deadline, not dangerous-condition meddelat körförbud. On-road: shortest suitable route to repair workshop/inspection; off-road and still banned: shortest suitable route to nearest inspection business. Does not grant general errands/commuting or waive other requirements.
G8_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

G8_sources.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
G8_sources.title: Vehicle Regulation (2009:211)
G8_sources.version: Consolidated live text; chapter 6 §§15–21 checked 13 October 2026
G8_sources.locator: Chapter 6 §15: first calendar month after missed inspection month; §21: prohibition until inspection performed; §§16–17: defects/result
G8_sources.excerpt: Ett körförbud enligt 15 eller 16 § gäller till dess en kontrollbesiktning har genomförts.
G8_sources.supports: Exact start/end of periodic-deadline ban; completed inspection rather than simply booking; follow new findings and any further prohibition/order.
G8_sources.fallback_reason: TS page establishes ban and travel exceptions but does not state precise legal endpoint. Linked primary regulation supplies that missing detail; not an extra duplicate source for the TS-supported ban.
G8_sources.scope_limits: Periodic inspection example only. Inspection being carried out ends §15 deadline ban; not a guarantee the result permits ordinary driving, since defects may create new ban/order. No implication a pass is always required merely to end the original deadline ban.
G8_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

G8_sources.title: Ställa av ditt fordon
G8_sources.locator: Köra ett avställt fordon; opening: prohibition does not automatically create off-road status
G8_sources.excerpt: Fordonet måste vara trafikförsäkrat och det får inte finnas några obetalda fordonsskatter.
G8_sources.supports: General off-road inspection exception requires traffic insurance and no unpaid vehicle taxes; ban does not automatically deregister car.
G8_sources.scope_limits: General off-road rule allows shortest suitable route to/from nearest inspection; when an overdue ban also applies, the additional ban restriction is to nearest inspection. Return is not automatically allowed while that ban continues. This is an explicit intersection of the agency conditions.
G8_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected
